summary: iptables options: goto a user chain, icmp_type, in_interface with + wildcards and negation, ip_version (ipv4, ipv6, both), jump target, and limit rate.
questions: How do I apply an iptables rule to both IPv4 and IPv6?
How do I match traffic coming in on a specific interface?
How do I rate-limit matches in iptables?
What does jump do vs goto?
How do I allow ICMP echo requests?

answer_card.title: iptables parameters (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `jump`: target (`ACCEPT`, `DROP`, user chain, extension); omitted = only counters
- `goto`: continue in a user chain without returning
- `in_interface`: e.g. `eth0`, `eth+`, `!eth0` (INPUT/FORWARD/PREROUTING)
- `ip_version`: `ipv4` (default), `ipv6`, `both`
- `icmp_type`: numeric, type/code, or name
- `limit`: e.g. `5/second`, `2/minute`
